assets.proposedAlt: Six regular E. coli Nissle 1917 rod reconstructions in four groups with sparse flagella and pili.
assets.proposedCaption: Strain-anchored morphology orientation for Escherichia coli Nissle 1917, shown as regular rods with simplified sparse flagella and pili. Morphology does not distinguish this strain from other E. coli and does not establish product identity, viability, purity, genome, dose, colonization, safety, probiotic action, or clinical effect; this is an educational reconstruction, not a micrograph.
